remarks: Experience refined waterfront living in this beautiful direct waterfront unit. Enjoy the sensation and luxury of expansive floor-to-ceiling glass doors leading to a grand patio. Offering seamless indoor-outdoor flow and panoramic views perched above lush gardens and an active marina in this well maintained and desirable private condominium community.   Complemented by elegant crown molding and remote powered blinds. The modern kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and recessed lighting. High quality easy to maintain marble floor bathroom.   The LOCATION is not only waterfront but a stones throw from Old Greenwich's charming downtown and Stamford's metropolis. This home is a boaters haven and an investors desire.  Private 1 bed, 1 bath, pool, hot tub, all located on a wonderful topography overlooking the inspiring harbor. This is simplified luxury move-in ready and designed for effortless coastal living.
